{{Quote|Our remote sensors reveal that a large number of capital ships have moved into position around our asteroid field. TIE fighters are sweeping the area in regular patterns. We are massing our own fleet in an attempt to gather the hive for escape.''"<br />"''Those capital ships have-formed a blockade, effectively cutting off our avenue of escape.|[[Jurfel]] and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="SFS" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[District Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] instituted a '''blockade''' of the [[Roche system]] after learning that new [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] were nearing completion. Thanks to the efforts of the undercover [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Salin Glek]], Nothos launched an attack on [[Research Station Shantipole]] to recover the prototypes, but was [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|foiled]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents. Indeed, the Rebels successfully managed to evacuate the facility with the two [[B-wing/E starfighter]] prototypes. The starfighters then engaged and disabled Nothos's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], allowing [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] transport and the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] fleet to escape the blockade.<ref name="SFS" /> Following this debacle, Nothos was demoted to commander in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref> Although the Rebel Alliance left the area, the Imperial fleet remained in the system and Imperial forces took the Verpine [[Hive Mother]] hostage to prevent further incident. The blockade of the Roche system was maintained firmly in place for most of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="SoR" />
